name: Happy Life Organics Veggie Deli
notes: All 4 photos are printed menu boards (2 pages x2 photos each: 'Our Veggie Food' and 'Snacks & Treats'), fully legible.

dishes.name: Sandwiches
dishes.description: Our big and famous toasted sandwich of mixed veggies, vegan dressings, cheese, and toppings of your choice!

dishes.name: Wraps
dishes.description: Fully customizable wrap of mixed veggies, vegan dressings, optional cheese, and toppings of your choice! Multiple tortilla types available!

dishes.name: Tortas
dishes.description: A big and toasted torta of mixed veggies, vegan dressings, cheese, and toppings of your choice!

dishes.name: Fruit Salad
dishes.description: A mix of fruits topped with granola, cottage cheese, and honey. Fruits included: 2 types of melon, watermelon, pineapple, mango, apple, banana, papaya, strawberries, and kiwi.

dishes.name: Green Salad
dishes.description: A mix of veggies of choice topped with optional avocado, feta cheese, and queso fresco.

dishes.name: Pico de Gallo
dishes.description: A mix of fruits topped with powdered chili, lemon, and salt. Fruits included: watermelon, green and orange melons, pineapple, mango, cucumber, jicama, and coco.

dishes.name: Chamango
dishes.description: Mango-based smoothie with chamoy sauce, tajin seasoning, and lemon, topped with mango and a tamarind candy stick.

dishes.name: Fresas c/ Crema
dishes.description: Fresh strawberries mixed with sour cream, condensed milk, some granola, and topped with whipped cream.

dishes.name: Escamocha
dishes.description: Mixed fresh fruit cup. It includes green and orange melons, papaya, watermelon, banana, granola, orange juice, and condensed milk topped with strawberries and whipped cream.

dishes.name: Mangada
dishes.description: Frozen mango popcicle with chamoy, chili powder, and lemon.

dishes.name: Bionico
dishes.description: Fruit mix that includes green and orange melons, papaya, watermelon, banana, granola, sour cream, and condensed milk all topped with whipped cream and strawberries.

dishes.name: Granada Cup
dishes.description: Fresh pomegranate grains in a sealed 12 ounce cup.
